headline: 黛安·沙利文获指定代理NCPC执行主任
summary: NCPC于2026年9月3日宣布，现行规划处主任黛安·沙利文将在阿科斯塔2026年9月18日离任时接任代理执行主任。

sources.title: NCPC Executive Director Marcel Acosta to Retire After 25 Years of Federal Service
sources.excerpt: NCPC Chairman Mark Paoletta announced that Current Planning Division Director Diane Sullivan will serve as Acting Executive Director, effective upon Acosta’s departure.
